defect: a control register is released from the first stage of a reset synchronizer
rationale: The control output's reset is driven by the first stage of a two-stage asynchronous-reset release chain, exposing it to metastability during release.
author: gpt-5.6-luna

provenance.adaptation: Reduced the life-cycle control receiver to a two-stage release chain and one buffered control register.

mutation.description: Tapped release_q[0] for the control register's asynchronous reset instead of the final stage.

labels.by: claude-sonnet (blind second labeller, design and constraints only)
labels.note: Functional flop reset uses first (metastable) synchroniser stage release_q[0].
